title: 12 Years Ago, This Classic Shonen Jump Anime Ended With No Chance of Return
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Hunter x Hunter manga! There’s no denying that Weekly Shonen Jump is the best manga magazine of all time as it has serialized some of the greatest series in history. Whether its Dragon Ball or Naruto , most of the iconic series made their mark in history after being serialized in the magazine. Among the beloved classics, one of them is Hunter x Hunter , which began serialization in March 1998. However, only a few years after the manga’s debut, it began facing frequent hiatuses due to Togashi’s health issues. The creator has been dealing with chronic health and severe back issues for more than 20 years while also working on the manga.

For several years, Shueisha has been accommodating Togashi with his schedule , supporting his decision to work at his own pace instead of following any kind of weekly or even quarterly schedule. This is exactly why the manga didn’t change. Regardless, the manga’s irregular schedule also caused the anime to face several issues since the original series from 1999 was discontinued only after 64 episodes. Produced by Nippon Animation, it featured the fan-favorite grainy visuals that breathed life into the incredible story by Togashi. However, after the original anime was discontinued in 2001, fans waited a decade for the reboot, which also faced the same consequences.

Hunter x Hunter Ended Its Reboot 12 Years Ago

The reboot debuted in 2011 with more polished visuals and a faithful adaptation than the original. Not to mention that with Madhouse producing the reboot, the hype was already bigger than ever. Madhouse is one of the most renowned studios in Japan, known for several timeless classics such as Monster, Death Note , and more. The studio was established in 1972, and it’s still going strong thanks to all the exceptional series. Madhouse didn’t disappoint with the reboot either, but it didn’t manage to continue the story for long after the 13th Hunter Chairman Election Arc. The anime had caught up with the manga by that time, and it had no choice but to wrap up on September 24th, 2014.

The manga moved on to the Succession Contest Arc , which has been ongoing for over a decade. Even after the anime’s success and incredible adaptation, there hasn’t been any confirmation of its return for 12 years now because of the manga’s unusual schedule. There’s also a possibility that Madhouse might never return with a sequel for the reboot since it has already been a long time and the studio hasn’t so much as dropped a hint of continuing the series. While the Succession Contest Arc is still ongoing, it has released around 80 chapters by now , which is more than enough for one season with two cours. While the anime’s future looks bleak, the manga continues to shock fans with its best arc ever.

The Succession Contest Arc Has Been Ongoing Since 2012

The Succession Contest Arc kicked off with Chapter 340, which was originally released in March 2012. Due to the frequent indefinite hiatuses, the arc is still ongoing. It’s one of the best arcs in the story as it puts Kurapika in the middle of the action . Kurapika has always been a fan-favorite character, and it was about time the series gave him the much-needed spotlight. The manga follows him when he gets entangled with the royal family of the Kakin Empire. The battle for the crown has begun, and the winner will be the sole survivor in a deathmatch among the 14 princes of the Empire. Kurapika takes on the job of protecting the 9th prince, but he’s disappointed to find out he has to protect the youngest prince of the Kingdom.

However, he still carries on with the job since his true objective is to recover the last remaining scarlet eyes of his clan from the 4th prince. The story has featured several exciting plot twists so far, and it’s already the second-longest arc in the series. The manga released new chapters this year while Togashi is working diligently on his return. Instead of following a regular schedule, HxH returns every once in a while to release at least 10 chapters on a weekly schedule before going on a hiatus again. Considering the pace of Togashi’s work and his regular updates on X, we can expect the manga to return next year with ten more chapters.

Head down to the comments to tell us if you are excited for the anime to return, or should it get a brand new adaptation instead? Or you could tell us your favorite D.Gray-man moment.

title: Dandadan Returns With Special New Look Ahead of Season 3
content:
DAN DA DAN is one of the many anime that fans are excited to see make its return with new episodes next year, and the wait is getting even tougher with a special new look helping to commemorate the Fall season. Yukinobu Tatsu’s DAN DA DAN was already one of the breakout successes from Shueisha’s Jump+ app , and it’s become an even more popular franchise thanks to the success of the anime’s first two seasons. But unfortunately, there’s just a bit more of a wait for the next season.

DAN DA DAN has a much wider gap for its third season than there had been seen with the first two seasons of the TV anime series, but there’s a way to help ease that wait with a special new poster released for the Fall season. Sharing a fun new look at Momo and the others ( though the anime’s official social media ) as they enjoy a great Fall evening, it’s a fun way to get reacquainted with the fan favorites ahead of the upcoming third season. Check it out below.

When Does DAN DA DAN Season 3 Come Out?

DAN DA DAN Season 3 is now in the works for a release sometime in 2027 , but has yet to confirm a more concrete release date or window as of the time of this writing. Science SARU will also be returning to oversee animation production on the new season, but any actual members of the production staff have yet to be revealed. It’s also likely that the voice cast for the anime will be reprising their respective roles for the new season, but treat that all as unconfirmed for now until it’s officially stated.

DAN DA DAN will hopefully be sharing much more about the coming season soon as it has also been announced to join the slate of titles with something to showcase during Shueisha’s Jump Festa 2027 event later this year . Taking place over the December 19-20 weekend in Japan, this annual event is where Shueisha shares updates on their biggest franchises and it’s likely where we’ll get a concrete update on the now in the works third season. Hopefully it’s even a full teaser or trailer.

What’s Going on in DAN DA DAN Season 3?

The wait for this third season of DAN DA DAN has been even tougher considering that the second season ended off on a huge cliffhanger for the future. Okarun and Momo had to contend with a giant alien kaiju in the final episodes, and the final moments of the finale saw a strange girl inside of the kaiju come out and embrace Okarun . That seemed to spark something within Momo upon seeing it, but we won’t see the fallout in action until this third season.

If you wanted to check out the anime and catch up with everything that has happened so far, you can find DAN DA DAN now streaming on multiple platforms such as Netflix, Hulu, Hulu on Disney+ and Crunchyroll. And you’re going to want to do so considering that it’s only going to get much wilder from here on out. But are you excited for DAN DA DAN Season 3? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: WEBTOON's The Mafia Nanny Gets Live-Action Series Adaptation at Hulu
content:
According to entertainment news outlet Deadline on September 17, Hulu is developing a live-action series adaptation of WEBTOON 's popular action romance webcomic The Mafia Nanny , with Charlize Theron serving as an executive producer.

Violet Matter is the webcomic's writer, and sh00 is drawing the art with assistance by roousuu and Drawniels. The story of The Mafia Nanny reads:

Being an Elite Nanny is simple: protect the charge, obey the principle, and don't get emotionally attached. Easier said than done when Davina's first client is a dangerously compelling Venetian underboss who's determined to get under her skin. What he wants from her, she can't imagine, but Gabriel Angelini drags her back into the glittering world of organized crime she thought she'd left behind forever. She might get answers about her past if she digs deep enough, but can she protect Mikey from his father's ambitions and keep her heart from getting tangled up in their treacherous web?

The webcomic had been nominated for Best Webcomic at the Ringo Awards and Digital Book of the Year at the Harvey Awards last year. The webcomic was also nominated for Best Webcomic again this year at the Ringo Awards.

The Mafia Nanny , one of the most successful English-language webtoons, has accumulated more than 420 million views globally.

Max Gill is an executive producer and will write the television adaptation, and 20th Television, Secret Menu, WEBTOON Productions, and Steady Collective will produce it. Other executive producers include Beth Kono, AJ Dix, and Matt Maher for Secret Menu; David Madden and Sera Tabb for WEBTOON Productions; and Dawn Olmstead for Steady Collective.

Deadline stated the project is believed to the first English-language live-action series adaptation of a WEBTOON IP.

Fans can read the webcomic on WEBTOON .

title: 3 Years Later, Major Fantasy Reboot Drops First Look Trailer for Season 2 Return – Watch
content:
A major fantasy series is coming back to screens with a new season of its official reboot series, and fans have gotten the first full look at its comeback with a new trailer showing it all off. While the Fall 2026 anime schedule has ushered in a new wave of releases that fans are undoubtedly going to be obsessed with over the next few months, there’s an even bigger wave of new releases coming to our screen next year. 2027 is teasing some big names coming our way, and that includes a big reboot’s return.

Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf is an official reboot anime series adapting Isuna Hasekura and Ju Ayakura’s light novels from the very beginning, and it’s gearing up to cover all sorts of ground that hasn’t been seen in the classic TV anime series from a decade ago . Making its return with a second season sometime next year, Spice and Wolf’ s reboot series has dropped a new trailer you can check out in action below.

Spice and Wolf Reboot Season 2 Confirms 2027 Release With New Trailer

Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf Season 2 is currently scheduled for a release sometime in 2027 , but it has yet to confirm a more concrete release date as of the time of this writing. If you liked the first season of the reboot then you’re in luck as the second season will bring back the production staff from the first season with Takeo Takashi serving as chief director, and Nobuyoshi Nagayama and Takahiro Majima directing the new episodes for studio Passione.

Koji Haneda and Rina Sugimoto are also slated to return to handle the character designs, and Kevin Penkin is returning to compose the music. The voice cast is all set to return to reprise their respective roles as well, and it’s even more impressive considering that they all returned from the first TV anime adaptation ten years prior with Jun Fukuyama as Kraft Lawrence, Ami Koshimizu as Holo, and Mai Nakahara as Norah Arendt. A new addition to the voice cast has been revealed with this new trailer too as Romi Park joins the cast as Eve Bolan.

What’s Next for Spice & Wolf’s New Reboot?

The first season of Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf has already done quite a lot to impress fans as it covered some materials that had been previously skipped over by the first TV anime adaptation in the 2010s . The reboot is also touting that it will be a much more complete experience than seen with the anime the first time around, so that’s yet another reason why this upcoming season is all the more intriguing as it teases some brand new ground not seen before.

Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf is also going to be counting down towards its second season debut with a special promotional train that was seen the first time around. The anime will be releasing a special poster for the reboot series on a monthly basis to celebrate each new passing season, and the first (which you can check out above) gives Holo a Halloween makeover. But what are you hoping to see from the Spice and Wolf reboot’s return? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Confirms Episode Count After Premiere
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is finally back in action with its highly anticipated third season, and a new update has revealed how many episodes it’s planning to stick around for. The Apothecary Diaries is leading off the new wave of returning franchises coming back for more episodes as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule, and with it fans are being treated to a welcome return from Maomao as she’s on the cusp of starting out a brand new mystery. But there’s still much more to explore.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has made its premiere, and the first episode of the new season has already been a big hit with fans thus fa r. While it’s only further setting the groundwork of what next to expect from the rest of the season, fans are already eager to see where it’s all going. Thankfully this season is going to have the same total number of episodes as the anime had for its first two seasons as revealed on its official website.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Reveals How Many Episodes It Will Last For

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has confirmed it will be running for 24 episodes, much like the first two seasons. Spread over four Blu-ray/DVD volumes hitting shelves in Japan, this third season will be broken into two cours. The first cour of the series will be airing its new episodes through the Fall, then the anime will be taking a break for a few months before returning for its second cour of episodes sometime next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule. So there’s quite a lot coming in the future for the anime.

If you wanted to catch the new episodes as they air in Japan, you can now find The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 streaming with Crunchyroll Crunchyroll in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and Indian Subcontinent ( along with being available for Netflix only in select regions of Asia ). With a big mystery at play as a new famine seems to be on the horizon, there might be a mystery that even Maomao won’t be able to solve before it’s all said and done. That makes it all the more intriguing.

What’s Next for The Apothecary Diaries?

The Apothecary Diaries has become such a massive franchise over the last few years that the third season is far from everything that’s set to make its debut this year. Coming to theaters in Japan later December is a feature film debut for the franchise, but international release plans for it have yet to be revealed as of this time. The Apothecary Diaries: The Movie is going to cover a story not seen in the light novels or anime releases, and you can actually check out the first trailer for it in the video above.

That’s not all that’s in the works for the franchise’s immediate future either. The Apothecary Diaries is also in the works on a new live-action series with Prime Video (that already has the creator’s seal of approval ), and even a new video game release. There’s something for every kind of fan coming, so are you excited for the future of The Apothecary Diaries ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Shonen Jump Teases Updates for Its Biggest Hits With New Livestream Coming Soon
content:
Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine is about to share some new updates soon, and has revealed a new livestream teasing some of its biggest hits coming our way this month. Shonen Jump fans are in for quite a treat through the rest of the year as there are still a number of major events with plans to share updates for some of the new franchise projects now in the works. But even with events like Jump Festa 2027 slated for later in the year, Shueisha is still planning some other new updates soon enough.

Shueisha has officially set a date for its next Jump Press livestream event as it’s set to make its debut on YouTube on October 12th. This event is teasing it will be featuring updates from some key franchises like Haikyu!!, Kagurabachi , and Black Clover , and it’s certainly something to keep an eye out for as there could also be a major anime adaptation announcement that fans have been eagerly anticipating. You can check out the announcement graphic for the livestream below.

Jump Press Teases Nue’s Exorcist Anime Update

Jump Press could end up being something much bigger than fans could have expected. The last major stream of this kind came earlier this Spring where it was first announced that Takeru Hokazono’s Kagurabachi would be getting an official TV anime adaptation of its own. This next event teases a new update for Kagurabachi as well alongside Haikyu!!, Black Clover and Mashle: Magic and Muscles , all franchises that now have a new anime adaptation in the works. That’s what makes Nue’s Exorcist included in the teased franchises all the more interesting for the event.

Kota Kawae’s Nue’s Exorcist has been running in Shonen Jump for about as much time as Kagurabachi has over the last few years, but it’s no closer to getting recognized with its own anime adaptation. Things started to move in a good direction when it was revealed that a website domain had been registered for the series , and that’s the same thing that happened shortly before the Kagurabachi anime was announced during the Jump Press seen earlier this Spring. So make sure to keep an eye out for this livestream just in case the next big Shonen Jump anime gets announced.

What’s Next for Shonen Jump?

Shonen Jump still has a packed year as not only are there going to be multiple chapters of each series hitting the magazine each week, but there are also plans to share updates about all of the new projects each of these franchises have in the works. Events like New York Comic Con have already staked their claims with new updates planned for Naruto and Dragon Ball Super , but there’s even more coming our way during the next Jump Festa event hitting this December.

If Nue’s Exorcist does confirm a new anime adaptation during this streaming event, we could see a much bigger update during Jump Festa 2027. title: Web Novel-Based Live-Action Series Take Charge of My Heart Unveils Main Trailer
content:
The web novel-based live-action Korean series Take Charge of My Heart released its main trailer on September 28, ahead of its October 9 premiere.

Based on the web novel of the same name, Take Charge of My Heart is a romantic comedy about Ho-rang Baek (Young-kwang Kim), a third-generation chaebol executive whose artificial heart battery is running out; and Bo-bae Na (Su-bin Chae), a drama writer who gained the ability to generate electricity after being struck by lightning as a child.

Bo-bae discovers that her electric ability has no effect on Ho-rang, while Ho-rang discovers that staying near her can recharge his artificial heart battery. The two eventually enter into a three-month contract involving physical contact so that Bo-bae can help keep Ho-rang's battery charged before his next surgery.

The newly released trailer follows Bo-bae as she meets Ho-rang, the only person immune to her electrical powers. After discovering that his battery recharges around her, Ho-rang proposes a three-month contract to stay together, saying he needs her help to survive.

Bo-bae, a drama writer who has never experienced a proper romance because of her powers, accepts the arrangement as she works on a "romance bucket list" for her latest script. Their unusual relationship becomes more complicated with the arrival of top star Eun-ho, Bo-bae's No. 1 fan, setting up a love triangle.

Currently, an official English version of the web novel is not available. Haebeon originally serialized the story on Naver Series.

title: 31 Years Later, Legendary Isekai Reboot Reveals First Look at Crunchyroll Premiere
content:
A legendary Isekai anime franchise is coming back to screens with a new anime on Crunchyroll after three decades, and now fans have gotten a first loom at what to expect from its big premiere. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is now underway as fans are about to see a whole new wave of releases to keep an eye out for over the next few weeks. While there are some brand new shows that are definitely worth watching, there’s one major franchise returning for a brand new take on its classic story.

CLAMP’s Magic Knight Rayearth series is coming back with a brand new reboot anime series taking on the classic from the very beginning , and that means a whole new generation of fans will be able to check it out for the first time. Now as the anime gears up for its premiere in just a few more days, Magic Knight Rayearth has revealed the first look trailer for its first episode and you can check it out below.

Magic Knight Rayearth Reboot Confirms Episode 1 Release Date

Magic Knight Rayearth Episode 1 is titled “From Another World” and will be making its debut on Wednesday, October 7th in Japan. Crunchyroll will be exclusively streaming the reboot episodes as they make their premiere as part of their jam packed Fall 2026 anime schedule. They have also announced plans to release an English dubbed version of the reboot, but no release schedule has been set just yet. And with the first look at its premiere episode, the reboot doesn’t seem to be drifting too far away from the original.

As for what to expect from the premiere itself, Magic Knight Rayearth teases more of the classic Isekai set up for its main trio, “Middle school student Hikaru Shidou, who visits Tokyo Tower for a social studies field trip, is drawn into another dimension along with Umi Ryuzaki from another school and Fuu Hououji. What awaited the three was a world unlike any they had ever seen――.” But with Isekai being such a bigger deal these days , this reboot has a much better chance at success than it ever had before.

What’s New for Magic Knight Rayearth Reboot?

This new version of Magic Knight Rayearth is directed by Yui Miura for E&H Production ( Ninja Kamui, Bullet/Bullet ) with Kadokawa and TMS Entertainment overseeing its production. Shigeru Murakoshi is handling the scripts with Satomi Watabe handling the character designs, and Yuki Kajiura, Takumi Ozawa and Shiho Terada composing the music. But everything about this new take thus far doesn’t seem to be straying too far away from CLAMP’s classic story .

There are quite a few new Isekai anime releases to keep an eye out for through the rest of the year, but make sure to keep an eye on this one. Though it might be a reboot of a classic series, it’s going to have a story that fits in perfectly with the modern era. Fans love Isekai anime these days, but wait until you see their weapons in action. Are you excited for the Magic Knight Rayearth reboot? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Charisma TV Anime Unveils More Staff, Key Visual
content:
The staff for the television anime of Evil Line Records label ( Hypnosis Mic ) and the intellectual property company Dazed's Chōjin-teki Share House Story Charisma (Superhuman Shared Residence Story: Charisma) project revealed on Sunday a new key visual along with more staff members.

The newly announced staff include:

• Character Design: Haru Watanabe

• Chief Animation Directors: Haru Watanabe, HANSEUNGAH

• Art Director: Seiki Tamura

• Color Key Artist: Yukiko Kakita

• Compositing Director of Photography: Tōru Fukushi

• Editor: Kumiko Sakamoto

• Music: Gesshoku Kaigi

• Sound Directors: Kyōko Wada, Shū Matsubara

• Sound Production: Rakuonsha

• Producers: Kotaro Sudo, Sōichiro Hirano, Yoshihiro Tominaga

Evil Line Records and Dazed launched the original project in 2021, and the project revolves around 2D characters who embody "charisma" — in the original sense of the term, which means divinely gifted elemental traits. They stay in a share house (a residence with some shared facilities, such as the kitchen) while aspiring for even higher goals.

The project's cast includes:

• Katsumi Fukuhara as Iori Motohashi, the charisma of obedience

• Genki Okawa as Terra, the charisma of self-love

• Masahiro Yamanaka as Rikai Kusanagi, the charisma of order

• Kenta Hosoda as Kei Sarukawa, the charisma of rebellion

• Saku Hyūga as Ohse Minato, the charisma of internal punishment

• Tomohisa Hashizume as Amahiko Tendō, the charisma of sex

• Yūki Ono as Fumiya Itō, the charisma of good and evil

Jōji Furuta ( Bad Girl , ēlDLIVE , Utano☆Princesama Legend Star , 2021 Shaman King ) is directing the anime at Pierrot Films . Original creator Shū Matsubara is overseeing and writing the series scripts, and Evil Line Records is in charge of music. Along with Matsubara, Dazed is credited for the original work, and Ebimo is credited for the original character designs. TBS Television is the production manager.

The anime will debut in January 2027 on TBS .

The project has already spawned musical releases and live concerts. Rin Manda and Iori Irino serialized the four-panel manga Charisma: Kyō mo Heiwa Desu in Kodansha 's Dessert magazine in January 2023 to December 2024 with two volumes compiled, and Sō Tobita serialized the Charisma: Charisma na Karera wa Charisma House de Karizumai-chū manga on Kodansha 's Comic Days site from February to December 2023 with two volumes compiled.

title: Spooky Shonen Jump Anime Drops New Season 2 Look Just in Time for Halloween
content:
Halloween is right around the corner as the Fall 2026 anime season is dropping all the new shows. It’s the final quarter of the year and possibly the biggest one so far thanks to the return of major shows such as Black Clover, The Apothecary Diaries , and more. While fans are busy with the exciting series of the season, a lot of upcoming series are also dropping new information in the meantime. Over the decades, Shueisha’s Shonen Jump magazines have always released some of the most exceptional series in the industry. The monthly magazine Jump Square falls within the category as it includes monthly Shonen manga series across all genres, including action, horror, and more.

One such series is Dark Gathering , an underrated horror manga written and illustrated by Kenichi Kondo. While the manga began serialization in 2019, it’s nowhere near its finale. On the other hand, an anime adaptation premiered in 2023, and it’s all set to return with a new season. Since spooky season is finally here, Dark Gathering dropped a new visual to hype fans for its return. The official X handle of Pony Canyon Anime shares the visual while confirming it features Kubizuka Daimyojin, a shrine that can be seen in the middle of eerie mist.

Does Dark Gathering Season 2 Have a Release Date?

The anime is all set to return in 2027 , but so far an exact release date hasn’t been confirmed yet. However, fans can expect new updates during Jump Festa 2027, which is scheduled to be held on December 20th and 21st. Jump Festa is the largest annual convention held by Shueisha, as it focuses on new announcements for anime, manga, and games, interactive exhibits, and unique merchandise that is often available only at the convention. As confirmed on Jump Festa’s official website , Dark Gathering will be holding a panel during the event’s Jump Studio stage.

Fans might get an official key visual or even a teaser, along with more updates during the event. Since the manga runs on a monthly schedule, the anime took four years to return so that the animation studio would have enough chapters for another season. We can expect the series to return to HIDIVE, where you can catch up with the first season. Furthermore, the anime is now also available on Prime Video, but fans still can’t find it on Crunchyroll or Netflix.

Dark Gathering Season 2 Will Be More Intense Than Ever

Among Shonen Jump series, Dark Gathering is known for its gritty details and gory visuals that aren’t suited for the faint of heart. Before the second season’s episode count is revealed, it’s impossible to determine how many chapters or arcs the anime will cover. The first season released 25 episodes, but there’s always a chance the sequel will return with only one cour that spans 12 to 13 episodes. The story follows Keitaro Gentoga, who wants to put his supernatural abilities behind him and live a normal life as a college student. However, his life takes a drastic turn when he meets Yayoi, a girl with similar supernatural abilities.

He soon finds himself entangled in her mission of capturing and enslaving violent spirits to prepare for battle against the spirit that stole the soul of Yayoi’s mother. The first season adapted 34 chapters from the manga, which means the sequel will at least wrap up the Kyoto Arc , where Yayoi, Keitaro, and Eiko travel to Kyoto to confront dangerous new ghosts and mysterious state-made gods. We can also expect the story to get even more intense with the introduction of more powerful monsters with unique abilities.
